entities.summary: Lucilla Perrotta is a female former professional beach volleyball player from Italy who represented her native country at the Summer Olympics in 2000 and 2004. Partnering with Daniela Gattelli, she claimed the gold medal at the 2002 European Championships in Basel, Switzerland.
